sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Read two bounds and print every Armstrong number between them, or -1 if none match.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It raises each digit to the digit count, appends matches to a string with a trailing space, and prints -1 when the string is empty.
